About

A small shop with a short list.

DUBLIN/01 sells sneakers and contemporary streetwear from Dublin to the rest of Ireland. We stock fewer things and stand behind every one of them.

Why “/01”

Every season is an edition. The number resets when the shop changes enough to deserve it. This is the first one.

What we stock

Runners and terrace classics from Nike, adidas, New Balance, ASICS and Salomon, chosen for how they wear on wet streets as much as how they look. Alongside them, our own label: heavy cotton basics, technical outerwear and a few accessories.

How we work

Prices include VAT. Delivery is free across Ireland over €100 and returns are free for 30 days. If something doesn’t fit, we would rather swap it than lose you.

About this site. DUBLIN/01 is a fictional brand built as a front-end portfolio project. Products, prices, stock and policies are demo content and no orders are processed. Photography from Unsplash, see image credits.
